description: Internal detail of TmGanttExportDialog: the built-in live preview of the chosen export format and options. Pure SVG/HTML (no JavaScript, no rasterization) — PDF/PNG draw the miniature page in the paper's aspect ratio with bars, optional critical path, today line and workload strip; Excel shows the first 20 rows of the selected columns; XML shows the task / dependency / milestone counts. The whole sketch is one role="img" element with a localized summary label over an aria-hidden body, and it collapses into a details on a fullscreen mobile dialog. Render it through the dialog (PreviewTasks); the dialog's PreviewContent slot is the host's way in.

parameters.name: Dependencies
parameters.description: Dependencies between the visible tasks (drawn as short connectors).

parameters.name: CriticalPathIds
parameters.description: Ids of the tasks on the critical path; painted only when the critical-path option asks for it.

parameters.name: Options
parameters.description: The dialog's current selection: format, paper, orientation, zoom, toggles, columns.

parameters.name: Layout
parameters.description: The resolved layout of the dialog; a fullscreen mobile dialog collapses the preview into a details.
